All signs.voice_body: Open your day to the gentle swell of optimism that arrives at 1:01 pm AEST, when the Moon and Jupiter dance in trine. This is the main aspect: it signals expansive feelings, a chance to share joy and generosity. The slow backdrop of Mercury opposite Saturn warns that ideas will feel heavy—your thoughts may feel boxed in, and communication could feel stilted. Let the trine lift that heaviness: write a quick, heartfelt note to someone you admire, offering a small kindness or a genuine compliment. Send that note today.
